'''Tatsu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]], Tatsu was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to the skilled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Like most Padawans, Tatsu constructed his [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed lightsaber [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at a young age. [[Bruu Jun-Fan]], his Master, took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. One notable event that he participated in was a [[skirmish on Orto Norwe]], where he and Jun-Fan, as well as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Grohto]], and [[Ko Solok]] traveled to [[Orto Norwe]] to apprehend [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

During the engagement with Opress, Tatsu called Oppress a coward<ref name="TSH" /> as Maul and Savage were fleeing from the [[Jedi task force|Jedi strike force]] with [[Esano's sister]], who had agreed to pay the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] for her rescue from [[the Scourge]] gang. In return for being called a coward, Savage cut off his right [[hand]]. Afterwards, the two Sith escaped along with the female, killing [[Grohto]] and several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the process. Since Tatsu was injured, he could not continue to the chase of Darth Maul and his brother to [[Pleem's Nexus]].

During the [[skirmish on Pleem's Nexus]], his Master Bruu Jun-Fan along with Ko Solok, was slain by Maul, and Tatsu was left masterless.
